messages:
laura: Quick sync - we're doing a runtime base-image rebuild this week after vuln triage turned up CVE-2026-1234 (libssl). Need to lock down KMS signing, RBAC, and verify audit exports before we cut the canary.

Tom: Ack. what's the plan for KMS key rotation? full rotate or create new key and dual-verify?

anika: Prefer new key + dual verification for a transition window. cosign supports verifying with multiple public keys so we can add verifier principal for the new key and keep old key for 10d.

nate: For RBAC: signer service should have roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier only. baker should have minimal sign rights but run as separate service account `svc-image-baker`. Deploy agents only get verifiers.

laura: I'm worried about accidental IAM drift. Can we enforce the key bindings via terraform and add an alert for any out-of-band IAM modifications?

anika: Yes - terraform for the binding + a Cloud Asset Inventory rule + Monitoring alert. Example IAM binding snippet: 

```hcl
resource \"google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding\" \"image_signer\" {
  crypto_key_id = var.images_signing_key
  role          = \"roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier\"
  members       = [\"serviceAccount:svc-image-baker@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"]
}

resource \"google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding\" \"image_verifier\" {
  crypto_key_id = var.images_signing_key
  role          = \"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter\"
  members       = [\"serviceAccount:svc-deployer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"]
}
```

nate: note: roles may need adjustment (signerVerifier vs encrypter) depending on key type (asymmetric vs symmetric). Confirm key algorithm.

Tom: Logging - ensure KMS AdminActivity and DataAccess logs flow to sec-logs. Right now our sink filters out adminActivity for cloudkms. We need:

- KMS AdminActivity and DataAccess
- Audit export to GCS + BigQuery for 180d retention
- Alert on kms.updateCryptoKey or policy change

secbot: Automated note: previous sink filter matched \"NOT protoPayload.serviceName: \\\"cloudkms.googleapis.com\\\"\" - updating policy will be required.

anika: Also enable artifact registry and container analysis event export so we get build provenance and vulnerability scanning events into the same dataset.

laura: rollout/canary plan suggestion:
1) Add new signing key in KMS (new key resource)
2) Add new verifier principals to CI and staging deployers
3) Build and sign 3 canary images with new key, push to staging, run smoke + vuln checks
4) If green, add new key to prod verifier principals, update pipeline to sign new images
5) Keep old key valid for 10 days; monitor verification failures and unexplained signature rejects
6) Revoke old key after window

Tom: What about emergency rollback if signing step fails in prod?

anika: Rollback plan: revert pipeline to use old key (we keep it active), revoke any accidental bindings, and trigger incident runbook. Also rotate staging keys first to validate process.

nate: saw a failed build earlier in staging: ops-bot: \"cosign: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller does not have cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign\". That was because svc-image-baker-staging lacked the signer binding.

laura: mitigation steps for that class of error:
- grant signer role to staging baker (hotfix) with 2-person approval
- track change in infra-changes log with reason and expiry
- run test-sign in staging to confirm

ops-bot: Build log snippet: 
```
2026-04-05T19:12:05Z sign-step: cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/img-sign/cryptoKeyVersions/1
ERROR: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller does not have cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign
```

anika: add terraform preflight that checks binding exists in each env before CI runs. We can add a `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` check in the pipeline.

Tom: monitoring/alerts - create an alert for: any IAM binding change on the signing key, KMS adminActivity events with change type UPDATE or SETIAM, and unexpected sign failures in CI (>3 within 1h).

secbot: FYI created a skeleton alert: \"KMS key IAM drift\" -> paging to oncall. Link: https://ops.internal/alerts/987

laura: vuln triage note: CVE-2026-1234 mitigated in rebuild by upgrading libssl to 3.1.4. Make sure SBOMs reflect the new version and that attestations are published to artifact registry.

nate: also add a check in the release pipeline verifying signature + attestation before promoting image to canary. Use cosign verify-attestation.

anika: agreed. We'll add `cosign verify --attestation` as gating step.

laura: open action items:
- anika: terraform PR for IAM bindings + preflight check (assign laura for review)
- tom: update sink filter to include KMS adminActivity, wire BigQuery export + retention policy
- nate: add CI preflight for KMS binding + add cosign verify-attestation gate
- secbot: finalize monitoring alerts and link to runbook

ops-bot: Note: scheduling prod change window for key binding at 2026-04-09T03:00Z; will send 72h notice.

laura: ok. schedule a 30min walkthrough right after the change window to validate logs and canary sign/verify. If anyone sees unusual failures in the next 48h, start incident channel #incident-kms-signing and tag oncall.

anika: PR opened: \"infra/kms: add signer binding, verifier principals, sink update\" https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/1309

Tom: merging once preflight tests pass and secbot gives green for alerts. thanks team.
